title: Replace Jira With a Custom Project Management Tool Built in 2 Hours
summary: Replace Jira and stop paying for features your team never uses. Build a custom project tracker in an afternoon — database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: A custom-built tool won't include velocity charts or sprint burndown reports by default. You can add sprint functionality — a Sprint field on tasks, grouping by sprint in the kanban view, a basic velocity count — but it takes additional prompts and iteration time. For teams that run formal retrospectives using velocity data to plan the next sprint, Jira or Linear is the faster path. That's one of the cases covered in "When Jira IS worth keeping" above.
